eps.t: The Crybaby: Usagi's Beautiful Transformation
eps.d: Usagi Tsukino is a schoolgirl who is always finding herself in unwanted trouble. One day she meets a talking cat, who reveals that dark forces are threatening the innocent. Usagi is transformed into Sailor Moon, a guardian who fights for justice.

eps.t: Punishment Awaits: The House of Fortune is the Monster Mansion
eps.d: A new house of fortune opens up in the Juban District and quickly gains popularity for its accurate predictions. But soon, the customers who had their fortunes read begin to act violent, including Gurio Umino, a boy who has a crush on Usagi.

eps.t: The Mysterious Sleeping Sickness: Protect the Girls in Love
eps.d: All the girls in town are tuning in to a late-night radio program called "Midnight Zero" that reads out love letters sent in by the listeners. Meanwhile, a strange sleeping sickness is plaguing the town that puts many people to sleep.

eps.t: Learn How to Be Skinny from Usagi
eps.d: Usagi is shocked to find out that she's gained weight from too much eating. Determined to get back into shape and fast, Usagi and her friends join a gym that advertises instant results for its members.

eps.t: Scent of a Monster: Chanela Will Steal Your Love
eps.d: Usagi asks her family if they can officially keep Luna as a pet, but her little brother Shingo strongly objects due to his fear of cats. Instead, Shingo brings home a pet Chanela, a creature that smells like perfume.

eps.t: Protect the Melody of Love: Usagi Plays Cupid
eps.d: One rainy day, Usagi bumps into Yusuke Amade, a famous musician who claims he is being chased by a monster. Realizing the man is telling the truth, Usagi and Luna decide to keep an eye on Yusuke by staking out the venue where he performs.

eps.t: Usagi Learns Her Lesson: Becoming a Star is Hard Work
eps.d: Usagi and Naru both dream of becoming a famous star like Mikan Shiratori, a graduate from their school. When the girls hear that Mikan is hosting a talent contest, they see their chance to achieve stardom.

eps.t: The Girl Genius is a Monster: The Brainwashing Cram School of Horror
eps.d: Usagi befriends Ami Mizuno, the school's smartest girl, who has an IQ over 300. But Luna, who senses an unknown energy coming from Ami, suspects her of being a Monster.

eps.t: Usagi's Disaster: Beware of the Clock of Confusion
eps.d: Usagi and Ami go to the city and buy a clock that resembles Luna. Later that day, Usagi is happy to learn that her mother bought the exact same clock as a gift. But that night, the clock emits a strange light that causes Usagi to become very impatient.

eps.t: The Cursed Bus: Enter Mars, the Guardian of Fire
eps.d: Several people who take the bus near the Hikawa Shrine have started to go missing. Usagi and her friends decide to investigate by visiting the shrine, where they meet Rei Hino, a girl with strong spiritual powers.

eps.t: Usagi vs. Rei: Nightmare in Dream Land
eps.d: The Sailor Guardians go to the Dream Land amusement park, where visitors have reportedly gone missing. Rei and Usagi pair up for the search. But much to Rei's frustration, Usagi is more focused on playing than finding the missing people.

eps.t: I Want a Boyfriend: The Luxury Cruise Ship is a Trap
eps.d: Rei goes off on a luxury cruise with Ami after winning tickets through the local lottery. Feeling left behind, Usagi sneaks aboard the ship disguised as a photographer.

eps.t: Girls Unite: The End of Jadeite
eps.d: Jadeite is given a final warning by Queen Beryl, who can no longer tolerate the general's continual failures. Realizing this is his last chance, Jadeite challenges the Sailor Guardians to a showdown at the airport.

eps.t: A New Enemy Appears: Nephrite's Evil Crest
eps.d: Rui is a talented tennis player at school, but Naru has noticed a dark change in her. Naru and Usagi go to investigate at Rui's tennis school. Meanwhile, with Jadeite out of the picture, Nephrite has stepped in to collect human energy for the great ruler.

eps.t: Usagi's Panic: Rei's First Date
eps.d: Ami brings Usagi and Rei to her favourite dating spot. Unfortunately, the place is soon to be demolished. Hearing the news, Rei decides to have a date with Mamoru at the park before it closes down, much to Usagi's annoyance.

eps.t: A Girl's Dream: Usagi Becomes a Bride
eps.d: The Juban District is having a contest to decide who can design the best handmade wedding dress. Upon learning that the prize will be a free luxury wedding reception, Usagi, Rei, and all the girls in town compete to design their own wedding dresses.

eps.t: Usagi's a Model: The Flash of the Monster Camera
eps.d: A young photographer named Kijin Shinokawa holds a modeling contest, and Usagi decides to enter. Mysteriously, all the girls who have entered the contest begin disappearing after Shinokawa photographs them!

eps.t: Shingo's Love: The Grieving Doll
eps.d: Shingo's friend Mika gives him a doll that she won in a doll-making contest. But Shingo unintentionally breaks the doll and hurts Mika's feelings after being teased by boys at his school. Taking his sister Usagi's advice, Shingo decides to apologise.

eps.t: Usagi's Joy: A Love Letter from Tuxedo Mask
eps.d: Usagi receives a love letter from Tuxedo Mask, stating that he'd like to meet her. But she soon finds out that all the girls in town received the same letter, including Naru, who believes that Tuxedo Mask is Masato Sanjoin.

eps.t: The Summer, the Beach, Youth and Ghosts
eps.d: It's summertime, and the girls search for a vacation spot so they can get away and focus on training. Instead of finding a beautiful beach destination, they settle on an ominous-looking mansion that has a very eerie service staff.

eps.t: Protect the Children's Dreams: Friendship Through Anime
eps.d: Ami spots Nephrite on the street and follows him down to an animation studio that is making the upcoming Sailor V movie. Suspecting that Nephrite is up to no good, Ami calls Usagi and Rei so they can investigate the studio.

eps.t: Romance Under the Moon: Usagi's First Kiss
eps.d: The Kingdom of Diamonds is hosting a party at the embassy to reveal their royal treasure to the world. Believing that the treasure may be the Legendary Silver Crystal, both the Sailor Guardians and the Dark Kingdom crash the party to find out.

eps.t: Wish Upon a Star: Naru's First Love
eps.d: Naru has fallen in love with Masato Sanjoin. Knowing that Sanjoin is really Nephrite, Usagi tries to convince Naru to give up on her feelings without having her learn the truth.

eps.t: Naru's Tears: Nephrite Dies for Love
eps.d: Nephrite uncovers Sailor Moon's true identity as Usagi Tsukino. But his attempt to finish her off is cut short when he learns that Naru has been kidnapped by Zoisite, who demands that Nephrite give up his Dark Crystal in exchange for the girl's safety.

eps.t: Jupiter, the Powerful Girl in Love
eps.d: A new girl named Makoto Kino transfers to Usagi's school, but her tough attitude seems to scare everyone away. Usagi, however, quickly becomes friends with her. Meanwhile, the Dark Kingdom is plotting to revive the Seven Great Monsters.

eps.t: Restore Naru's Smile: Usagi's Friendship
eps.d: The Sailor Guardians grow in strength with its newest member Sailor Jupiter joining the team. Sailor Moon is appointed as team leader and is handed the Moon Stick, an item that can locate the seven Rainbow Crystals.

eps.t: Crushing on Ami: The Boy Who Can See the Future
eps.d: Usagi learns that a transfer student named Ryo Urawa seems to have a crush on Ami, and tries to help him out. But Ryo, who secretly possesses the ability to foresee the future, finds out that he is destined to fight Ami as a Monster.

eps.t: The Painting of Love: Usagi and Mamoru Get Closer
eps.d: Usagi and Naru attend an art exhibit by Yumemi Yumeno, whose works are known for helping people find love. Usagi is surprised when she and Mamoru, who also happen to be at the exhibit, are both asked by Yumemi to become models for her latest painting.

eps.t: Total Chaos: The Messy Love Rectangle
eps.d: Usagi and Makoto are shocked to discover their crush Motoki has a girlfriend named Reika. His relationship is in jeopardy, however, due to Reika's chance to study abroad. With nothing to lose, Usagi and Makoto aggressively go after Motoki's affection.

eps.t: Grandpa Loses Control: Rei in Danger
eps.d: Grandpa Hino has become emotionally unstable, causing Rei to worry. The new apprentice Yuichiro tries to cheer her up by blaming Grandpa's behaviour on the weather. Realising that Yuichiro likes Rei, Usagi tries to help their relationship along.

eps.t: Love and Chased: Luna's Worst Day Ever
eps.d: Usagi and friends meet a girl who they believe holds the final Rainbow Crystal. Zoisite also pursues her. But when neither Usagi's Moon Stick nor Zoisite's Dark Crystal reacts to the girl, they realize it's her pet cat that possesses the Rainbow Crystal!

eps.t: Umino's Resolve: I'll Protect Naru
eps.d: Umino seems to have fallen in love with Naru. Unfortunately, Naru only considers Umino a friend, so Usagi decides to play Cupid by getting free tickets to the amusement park and urges them to go on a date together.

eps.t: Enter Venus, the Last Sailor Guardian
eps.d: When the exploits of a Sailor Moon imposter become quite the sensation, the real Sailor Guardians step in to investigate. They soon learn the whole thing is a trap set by the Dark Kingdom to lure out Tuxedo Mask and seize the Rainbow Crystals.

eps.t: The Shining Silver Crystal: The Moon Princess Appears
eps.d: Now that Sailor V (Sailor Venus) has joined the team, all of the Sailor Guardians are finally together! Zoisite has discovered that Tuxedo Mask is actually Mamoru Chiba and challenges him to a showdown for possession of the Rainbow Crystals.

eps.t: Returning Memories: Usagi and Mamoru's Past
eps.d: Tuxedo Mask is fatally wounded while protecting Sailor Moon. Responding to Sailor Moon's tears, the seven Rainbow Crystals gather to form the Legendary Silver Crystal, and she is transformed into Serenity, the Moon Princess that everyone has been seeking.

eps.t: Usagi's Confusion: Is Tuxedo Mask Evil?
eps.d: Usagi is haunted by dreams of Tuxedo Mask, who has been abducted by the Dark Kingdom. Minako takes Usagi to a popular hair salon in the Juban District, hoping it will help take her friend's mind off of her recent worries.

eps.t: Let's Become a Princess: Usagi's Bizarre Training
eps.d: Usagi decides to take the Princess Seminar course at Rose Mansion to become more princess-like, and the other Sailor Guardians join her. But unbeknownst to them, this seminar is actually a trap set up by the Dark Kingdom to find Sailor Moon.

eps.t: The Snow, the Mountains, Friendship and Monsters
eps.d: Usagi and friends go to a ski resort to participate in the Moon Princess Contest, unaware that it's part of Kunzite's plan to eliminate the real Moon Princess. During the contest, Usagi & Rei fall for the monster's trap and get buried in the snow.

eps.t: Paired with a Monster: Mako, the Ice Skating Queen
eps.d: Olympic figure-skating gold medalists Janelyn & Misha offer to coach groups of five girls. Usagi and her friends decide to investigate. Makoto, a master skater, gracefully glides across the ice and soon begins to receive personal lessons from Misha.

eps.t: The Legendary Lake Yokai: The Bond of Usagi's Family
eps.d: Usagi goes on a family vacation to the hot springs, where she is unexpectedly reunited with Mamoru. But due to the Dark Kingdom's brainwashing, Mamoru no longer remembers Usagi or even who he really is.

eps.t: I Won't Run Away from Love Anymore: Ami vs. Mamoru
eps.d: The Dark Kingdom is trying again to revive the Seven Great Monsters. With five of them already under enemy control, Sailor Mercury and Jupiter scramble to protect Ryo Urawa, while Moon, Mars and Venus stay behind at Hikawa Shrine to protect Grandpa Hino.

eps.t: Sailor Venus' Past: Minako's Tragic Love
eps.d: Minako receives a surprise visit from Katarina, an Interpol officer from the UK and Minako's former partner while crime fighting as Sailor V. The two solved many cases together until a tragic incident forced them to go their separate ways.

eps.t: Usagi Abandoned: The Falling-Out of the Sailor Guardians
eps.d: Sailor Moon and the other Sailor Guardians appear to have a falling-out. But it's all part of the plan to locate the enemy's hideout. Also, a nosy journalist named Nana Asahina, who they suspect is a monster, approaches them.

eps.t: Usagi's Awakening: A Message from the Distant Past
eps.d: Sailor Venus finds the Dark Kingdom's hideout. The Sailor Guardians fall into Kunzite's trap, which hurls them into the past. The girls find themselves in a world called Silver Millennium, where they meet Queen Serenity, the mother from Usagi's past life.

eps.t: Death of the Sailor Guardians: The Tragic Final Battle
eps.d: The Sailor Guardians head out into the Arctic Circle. Having anticipated their arrival, Queen Beryl sends the DD Girls, who ambush them. To Sailor Moon's horror, the Sailor Guardians fall one after another as they try to defeat the DD Girls.

eps.t: Usagi's Eternal Wish: A Brand New Life
eps.d: Sailor Moon confronts Queen Beryl & Endymion. She attempts to free Endymion from Queen Beryl's control, but his brainwashing cannot be undone. With the fate of the world hanging in the balance, Sailor Moon is forced to fight the man she loves.

eps.t: Moon Returns: The Mysterious Aliens Appear
eps.d: Two months have passed since the Sailor Guardians defeated the Dark Kingdom. Having lost all memory of being Sailor Moon, Usagi now lives her life as an ordinary girl.

eps.t: For Love and for Justice: Sailor Guardians Once Again
eps.d: Sailor Moon finds herself facing new enemies from outer space, who call themselves Ail and An. The two aliens disguise themselves as humans to go after other human energy.

eps.t: For Whom is the White Rose? The Moonlight Knight Appears
eps.d: Usagi, Mako, and Ami see a boy being attacked by one of Ail and An's Cardian monsters. To Mako's surprise, the boy turns out to be her childhood friend Shinozaki.

eps.t: Usagi's Crisis: The Tiara Stops Working
eps.d: Usagi goes to a virtual reality arcade that has just opened up in the Juban District, where she unexpectedly runs into Mamoru, as well as Seijuro and Natsumi.

eps.t: A New Transformation: Usagi's Power-Up
eps.d: Usagi and her friends are enjoying the cherry blossoms, which are in full bloom, when the Cardian Leshy attacks them. During the fight, the Sailor Guardians are caught, and Sailor Moon loses her power to transform.

eps.t: The Targeted Kindergarteners: Venus to the Rescue
eps.d: Minako befriends a little girl named Mie who is a huge fan of Sailor Moon. Meanwhile, Ail and An send a Cardian to steal energy from young children.

eps.t: Mamoru and Usagi's Babysitting Mayhem
eps.d: Usagi and Mamoru find themselves looking after a baby boy while his mother is recovering from having her energy stolen by a Cardian.

eps.t: The School Festival is for Me?! Queen Rei's Song
eps.d: A school festival is going to be held at T.A. Girls' Academy, which Rei attends. When Usagi and Ami go to check up on her, they find Rei busy overseeing the setup and events.

eps.t: Is Seijuro the Moonlight Knight? Mako on Fire
eps.d: Ami and Makoto are trying to figure out who exactly the Moonlight Knight is. Suspecting that Seijuro and the Moonlight Knight may be the same person, Makoto volunteers to investigate by getting closer to Seijuro.

eps.t: Steal a Kiss from Mamoru! An's Project Snow White
eps.d: Usagi and the girls get into an argument over who gets to play Snow White in the upcoming play with Mamoru. After drawing straws, Natsumi gets the part, much to Usagi's frustration.

eps.t: After School Trouble: Usagi is a Target
eps.d: Usagi and Natsumi both get detention after angering Ms. Haruna during class. The two start working on their assignment when a Cardian suddenly shows up.

eps.t: Disconnecting Love: The Raging Makai Tree
eps.d: Ail and An learn that the Makai Tree is beginning to die from lack of energy. Meanwhile, Usagi and her friends visit Seijuro and Natsumi's apartment after hearing that Natsumi is not feeling well.

eps.t: True Love Awakens: The Makai Tree's Secret
eps.d: While visiting Seijuro and Natsumi's apartment, Usagi and Mamoru come under attack by the Makai Tree.

eps.t: Angel or Devil? The Mysterious Girl from the Sky
eps.d: A mysterious girl suddenly falls down from the sky, much to Usagi and Mamoru's surprise. Calling herself "Usagi," the girl demands Usagi to tell her where the Silver Crystal is.

eps.t: Usagi Devastated: Mamoru Declares a Break-Up
eps.d: Usagi wakes up one morning to find that Chibi-Usa has gone missing. Meeting up with Mamoru, the two search the neighborhood for Chibi-Usa, eventually finding her sitting alone at the park.

eps.t: A Guardian's Friendship: Goodbye, Ami
eps.d: Ami is offered a chance to study abroad in Germany, which would bring her one step closer to her dream of becoming a doctor. Knowing how important this is to her, Usagi and the others urge Ami to accept the offer.

eps.t: Women Must Be Strong and Beautiful: Rei's New Special Technique
eps.d: Rei's grandfather is upset over the fact that Hikawa Shrine has had fewer female visitors lately. He then decides to retire as head priest to start a new business, which would allow him to be around young women, much to Rei's annoyance.

eps.t: In Search of the Silver Crystal: Chibi-Usa's Secret
eps.d: Rubeus sends down Petz and her Droid to search and capture Chibi-Usa. Meanwhile, Chibi-Usa is calling someone on her Luna P ball telling her she wants to go home.

eps.t: Dispute Over Love: Minako and Makoto's Conflict
eps.d: Minako and Makoto clash over their opposing views on love. Wanting to break the tension, Usagi takes the girls to check out a new accessory shop, unaware that Petz and Calaveras run the place.

eps.t: Usagi's Parental Love: The Curry Romance Triangle
eps.d: Chibi-Usa's class is having a parent-child curry party this weekend. After hearing that neither Kenji nor Ikuko can attend due to prior commitments, Usagi decides to go in their place.

eps.t: The Beach, the Island and a Vacation: The Guardians' Break
eps.d: The girls enjoy some vacation time on an island. But during lunch Chibi-Usa and Rei get into a small fight, causing an angry Chibi-Usa to go out to the sea alone.

eps.t: Protect Chibi-Usa: Clash of the Ten Warriors
eps.d: Chibi-Usa leaves the house after being scolded by Usagi. Roaming the streets alone, Chibi-Usa is overcome with sadness and begins to cry, which draws the attention of Rubeus and the Four Spectre Sisters.

eps.t: Awaken the Sleeping Beauty: Mamoru's Distress
eps.d: Mamoru has a dream in which a mysterious voice warns him that being with Usagi will bring her great misfortune. Meanwhile, Sailor Moon is put into a deep coma after being attacked by a Droid.

eps.t: Battle of the Flames of Love! Mars vs. Koan
eps.d: Wiseman predicts that Chibi-Usa will appear at Hikawa Shrine. Learning of this, Rubeus orders Koan to go down there and eliminate their target.

eps.t: For Friendship! Ami vs. Berthier
eps.d: Ami enters the World Chess Tournament, which is being held at the newly constructed Chess Tower. But Bertheir is also there, forcing Ami to transform and reveal her identity as a Sailor Guardian to the enemy.

eps.t: Rubeus the Heartless: The Tragic Sisters
eps.d: Having run out of patience over the Spectre Sisters' continual failures, Rubeus gives Petz and Calaveras one last chance to eliminate Rabbit and the Sailor Guardians once and for all.

eps.t: A UFO Appears: The Sailor Guardians Abducted
eps.d: Chibi-Usa finally learns that Usagi is Sailor Moon. Eager to return to the future, she steals Usagi's Silver Crystal and flees, only to be ambushed by Rubeus.

eps.t: Defeat Rubeus: The Battle in Space
eps.d: Rubeus succeeds in taking four of the five Sailor Guardians prisoner. He then demands that Sailor Moon bring Chibi-Usa and the Silver Crystal to him in exchange for the girls' lives.

eps.t: The Mysterious New Guardian: Sailor Pluto Appears
eps.d: Chibi-Usa falls into a coma after coming down with a mysterious fever. Usagi and the others are at a loss for what to do, when a Sailor Guardian calling herself Sailor Pluto suddenly appears before them.

eps.t: Magic of Darkness: Esmeraude's Invasion
eps.d: The Black Moon clan sends down its next operative, Esmeraude, to open the Dark Gate in 20th century Tokyo.

eps.t: Shared Feelings: Usagi and Mamoru in Love Once Again
eps.d: Usagi is still depressed over Mamoru calling off their relationship. Ami and Mako try to cheer her up by taking Usagi to a promise ring workshop.

eps.t: Venus Minako's Nurse Mayhem
eps.d: A strange new flu is causing everyone in town to get sick, including the Sailor Guardians. Minako is the only one still healthy and takes it upon herself to look after her sick friends.

eps.t: Artemis' Adventure: The Monster Animal Kingdom
eps.d: Artemis is out to prove he is capable after being teased by Luna. While on patrol, he encounters a suspicious-looking man who is gathering stray animals.

eps.t: The Terrifying Illusion: Ami All Alone
eps.d: The school test results are posted, and Ami is once again at the top of her class. But she soon finds herself becoming isolated after some of her schoolmates spread false rumors that she cheated on the test.

eps.t: The Dark Gate is Completed? The Targeted Elementary School
eps.d: After being out sick a couple of days, Chibi-Usa returns to school eager to see her friends. But to her surprise, her friends and teachers begin attacking her.

eps.t: Journey to the Future: Battle in the Space-Time Corridor
eps.d: Chibi-Usa finally decides to return to the future to save her mother. With support from the Sailor Guardians and Tuxedo Mask, she overcomes her fears and opens the Door of Space and Time.

eps.t: The Shocking Future: Demande's Dark Ambition
eps.d: Arriving in the future, the Sailor Guardians stand in shock as they see the ruins of what used to be Crystal Tokyo. Chibi-Usa goes missing afterwards, and as they search for her, the group encounters a man who looks exactly like Tuxedo Mask.

eps.t: Wiseman's Evil Hand: Chibi-Usa Disappears
eps.d: Tuxedo Mask rescues Sailor Moon from Black Moon's castle. But before they can all celebrate, a giant dragon suddenly appears to destroy the Crystal Palace.

eps.t: The Dark Queen: Birth of Black Lady
eps.d: Wiseman brainwashes Chibi-Usa and turns her into the Dark Queen known as Black Lady. Realizing that something has happened to Chibi-Usa, the Sailor Guardians return to present-day Earth to find her.

eps.t: Saphir Dies: Wiseman's Trap
eps.d: Saphir learns of Wiseman's true intentions and tries to warn his brother, only to be attacked by Wiseman himself. Barely managing to escape, Saphir is surprised when he is saved by Petz and her sisters.

eps.t: Believing in Love and the Future: Usagi's Decision
eps.d: The sudden appearance of the giant Malefic Black Crystal Tower is wreaking havoc across the world. Sailor Moon and the Guardians decide to enter the tower to put an end to this once and for all.

eps.t: The Final Battle Between Light and Dark: Pledge of Love to the Future
eps.d: The Dark Gate opens, and Dark Energy spreads everywhere. To stop this, the Sailor Guardians must defeat Black Lady.

eps.t: Usagi and the Girls' Resolve: Prelude to a New Battle
eps.d: Peace has returned, and the Sailor Guardians take a moment to look back at their past battles as they prepare for their next challenge.

eps.t: Premonition of the Apocalypse: The Mysterious New Guardians Appear
eps.d: A new enemy called the Death Busters appears, an organization whose members aim to get their hands on the talismans that can only be found in pure-hearted humans. If they succeed, they will be able to obtain the Holy Grail and use it to take over the entire world.

eps.t: The Rod of Love is Born: Usagi's New Transformation
eps.d: The Silver Crystal loses its shine—and that means Usagi cannot transform. Mamoru tries to cheer Usagi up by taking her to an area in town that has become the home of a bunch of stray cats.

eps.t: A Handsome Boy? Haruka Tenoh's Secret
eps.d: Usagi and Minako sneak off to the arcade to take a break from their life of studying. While enjoying the latest racing game, the girls are approached by a handsome student named Haruka Tenoh, who wishes to join them for a friendly match.

eps.t: Usagi's Idol: The Graceful Genius Michiru"
eps.d: Usagi asks her friends to help her become a better person worthy of being Mamoru's bride. But to her disappointment, the girls do not take her seriously. Feeling rejected, Usagi is heading home when she spots Michiru gracefully playing the violin and wishes she could be just like her.

eps.t: Protect the Pure Heart: The Three-Way Battle
eps.d: Motoki's little sister Unazuki is a pure-hearted girl who dreams of sharing her first kiss with the person she truly loves. But when her pure heart is stolen by a Daimon, Unazuki's dream turns into a nightmare as she starts to try to kiss anyone in sight.

eps.t: Let Moon Help with Your Love Problems
eps.d: A small misunderstanding causes Umino and Naru to believe that the other is no longer interested in them. Wanting to help her friends make up, Usagi suggests the couple enter a love contest that will take place at the Lovers Park' opening ceremony.

eps.t: Coldhearted Uranus: Makoto in Danger
eps.d: Kaolinite has a new target: Makoto. When Haruka and Michiru find out, they decide to use Makoto as bait in order to obtain her talisman.

eps.t: The Labyrinth of Water: Ami Targeted
eps.d: Kaolinite sets her eyes on Ami, believing that the famous girl genius would possess a pure heart full of confidence. But in reality, Ami is having doubts about her own identity, worrying that her academic skill is the only thing that defines her.

eps.t: To Save Our Friends: Moon and Uranus Join Forces
eps.d: Realizing that the two mysterious Sailor Guardians Uranus and Neptune are also after the talismans, Kaolinite sends a Daimon to get rid of them for good.

eps.t: A Man's Kindness: Yuichiro, Heartbroken by Rei
eps.d: Rei's been spending the past several nights chanting to learn the meaning behind the strange nightmares she's been having. Worried for her health, Yuichiro tries to help Rei out, only to realize that there is not much he can do.

eps.t: I Want to Quit Being a Sailor Guardian: Minako's Dilemma
eps.d: Seeing the happy couples around her, Minako starts questioning her life as a Sailor Guardian and the sacrifices she has to make. Minako's doubt intensifies after she learns that one of her schoolmate used to like her but has since moved on to find a new girlfriend.

eps.t: Usagi in Tears: A Glass Slipper for My Birthday
eps.d: Kaolinite is confident that she has finally found a person possessing the talisman. Aided by a Daimon, Kaolinate goes after her next target: Usagi.

eps.t: The Stolen Pure Heart: Usagi's Crisis
eps.d: Taking Tuxedo Mask as a hostage, Kaolinite tells Usagi and the Sailor Guardians to come to the top of Tokyo Tower for their final showdown. Desperate to save her love, a powerless Usagi leaves her friends behind and heads to the tower alone.

eps.t: The Arrival of a Tiny Pretty Guardian
eps.d: Following Kaolinite's death, Eudial takes over and begins searching for the talismans. Her first target is Maya, a gifted and world-renowned Taiko drummer.

eps.t: Making New Friends: Chibi Moon's Adventure
eps.d: Chibi-Usa has returned from the future to complete her training as a Sailor Guardian. She is to learn how to make friends in the twentieth century.

eps.t: I Want Power: Mako Lost in Doubt
eps.d: After experiencing a humiliating defeat by a Daimon, Makoto decides to retrain herself in the mountains. There, she meets a monk named Kakusui who gives Makoto the advice she needs to overcome her self-doubt.

eps.t: The Bond of Destiny: Uranus's Distant Past
eps.d: The girls are taking a tour at one of the high schools they plan to apply to next year. There, they meet Elza Gray, a star track-and-field athlete who used to compete against Haruka Tenoh back in middle school.

eps.t: Art is an Explosion of Love: Chibiusa's First Love
eps.d: Chibi-Usa is stunned at the sight of Usagi and the others enjoying an apple pie since she actually made the pie especially for Masanori, the boy she has a crush on.

eps.t: Usagi Dancing to the Waltz
eps.d: Mamoru and the girls receive an invitation to a party hosted by Edwards, an Englishman who lives alone on the outskirts of the town.

eps.t: The Shocking Moment: Everyone's Identities Revealed
eps.d: Minako realizes that she is the only Sailor Guardian who has not been targeted by a Daimon. Fearing that she may not be purehearted like her friends, Minako decides to participate in several blood drives so that she can be the Daimon's next target.

eps.t: The Death of Uranus and Neptune: The Talismans Appear
eps.d: Michiru and Haruka sense that soon they will find the talismans. Meanwhile, Eudial has deduced the identities of the ones possessing the talismans and challenges Uranus and Neptune to a final showdown to settle their score once and for all.

eps.t: The Holy Grail's Mystical Power: Moon's Double Transformation
eps.d: Uranus and Neptune are revealed to be the ones possessing the talismans. In order to save the two, the Sailor Guardians go after Eudial, who is on the run with their talismans.

eps.t: Who is the True Messiah? Chaos of Light and Darkness
eps.d: Mimete takes over for the deceased Eudial to gather the pure hearts necessary to awaken the Messiah of Silence. Mimete sets as her first target Yosaku Eda, a popular actor whom she is also a fan of.

eps.t: A House Filled with Evil Presence: The Beautiful Hotaru's Secret
eps.d: Usagi is very intrigued when she hears Chibi-Usa is going to a "friend's" house to play. She heads out with Chibi-Usa to get a look at her handsome new boyfriend, but Usagi finds herself at the house of Hotaru, a sickly girl.

eps.t: I Love Idols: Mimete's Dilemma
eps.d: Minako and Mimete enter a movie audition where the winner gets to costar with the idol Jinta Araki. As his longtime fans, both girls are eager to win the role no matter what.

eps.t: Shadow of Silence: The Pale Glimmer of a Firefly
eps.d: The Three Guardians of the Outer Solar System sense something dangerous lurking inside Hotaru Tomoe's personality. Noticing Chibi-Usa becoming fast friends with the girl, Haruka warns Usagi and the others to keep Chibi-Usa away from Hotaru for her own safety.

eps.t: Sunny Skies After a Storm: A Friendship Dedicated to Hotaru
eps.d: Hotaru tries to avoid Chibi-Usa out of fear that her other violent personality will someday bring harm to her only friend. Undaunted, Chibi-Usa invites Hotaru to go on a picnic.

eps.t: Higher and Stronger: A Cheer from Usagi
eps.d: Shun Hayase is a high school athlete who sets a new national record in the men's high jump after overcoming health issues as a child. Inspired by his story, Hotaru gets up the courage to visit the practice field where Shun is training in order to hand him a letter showing how much she looks up to him.

eps.t: The Battle Inside the Demonic Space: The Sailor Guardians' Gamble
eps.d: A freak accident caused by Mimete results in Hotaru's house getting pulled into a dimensional rift, with Hotaru and Chibi-Usa trapped inside.

eps.t: The Messiah of Silence Awakens? Stars of Destiny
eps.d: Usagi and her friends visit a new planetarium, which has opened in the Juban District. Mimete, who has her eyes on the guest DJ Thomas Harris, attacks with Daimon u Choten.

eps.t: An Invasion from another Dimension: Mystery of Infinity Academy
eps.d: Usagi and her friends sneak into Mugen Academy in search of Hotaru, who has gone missing. Meanwhile in the auditorium, Mimete attends the lecture of subspace physicist Sergei Asimov in hopes of outdoing her successor, Tellu.

eps.t: A Heart-Snatching Demon Flower: Tellu, the Third Witch
eps.d: A new variety of flower called Tellun is being sold at a flower shop in the Juban District. But as it turns out, the flowers are actually a monster plant created by Tellu of Witches 5 for the purpose of stealing and gathering large quantities of pure hearts at once.

eps.t: Believe in Love: Ami, the Kindhearted Guardian
eps.d: Usagi and the others sneak into the practice examination site of the suspicious Mugen Academy, where they meet a student named Yui Bido who takes an interest in Ami's intelligence. Inviting her to a secret underground lab, Yui shows Ami her projects and explains the teaching philosophy of Mugen Academy.

eps.t: Shadows of Destruction: The Messiah of Silence Awakens
eps.d: The last member of the Witches 5, Cyprine, manages to steal a large number of pure hearts from the students of Mugen Academy. Meanwhile, Kaolinite takes notice of Chibi-Usa's power and kidnaps her!

eps.t: The Imminent Terror of Darkness: Struggles of the Eight Guardians
eps.d: The revived Mistress 9 attempts to call Pharaoh 90, an energy life-form from another dimension, to Earth. Meanwhile, Usagi and the others are unable to enter the academy due to the powerful dark energy shielding the area.

eps.t: The Shining Shooting Star: Saturn and the Messiah
eps.d: Hotaru's and Mistress 9's consciousnesses engage in a fierce battle. Sailor Moon gives up the Holy Grail to Souichi Tomoe in order to save Hotaru's heart, only for it to fall into the hands of Mistress 9!

eps.t: A New Life: Parting of the Stars of Destiny
eps.d: Following the fight with Pharaoh 90, Usagi and her friends search for Hotaru in the ruins of Mugen Academy. Haruka and Michiru appear in front of them and for some reason begin to berate Usagi, stating that she is unworthy to be their future Queen.

eps.t: A Guardian's Realization: Strength Lies Within a Pure Heart
eps.d: The Door of Space and Time is opened, allowing Chibi-Usa to return to the future. Usagi and Chibi-Usa vow to see each other again, but at the same time, the final Daimon rises from the ashes of Mugen Academy and begins its assault!

eps.t: Meeting of Destiny: The Night Pegasus Dances
eps.d: One night, Chibi-Usa has a dream where she meets a Pegasus in a mysterious forest. The Pegasus asks that she keep their meeting a secret, and then disappears.
